title: Page 146
transc:
Capt Sam Bruch Louisville  Washn Aug 7th 1864
Grapes Topsy postpone for Shelby Burr patent zebra
your immediate attention is directed to the following
wrangle virgin insert Jones penfield stop you will 
please see Surgeon Ferry in person & hear
his statement zodiac If you deem his platation
trust worthy & important send its substance by
pembroke wreathe zebra If you think a personal
interview with me important Send him here under
adequate saddle that will take care he does
not escape webster Brutus is it all right


F. T. Beckford  Wash'n Aug 9th 930 am 1864 
Aug Franklin Enigma For Palestine In galls Tulip up on
the present report of Officers I think that all the
wagons Talbot Dawson Pelham and Talbot Pedlar which has been
sent to this place should reward the wharf Pike Their
drivers are needed to relieve ours yacht Ship them Panther
possible yard A large number of waltzers has been engaged
and ordered to Bridle to be ready for any Supper
in Salem Tulip If on their arrival they are not
needed there it will be well for them to return
to Bunyan and wait Events Pause Consult how ever in
regard to this with the Polk Talbot Saints on the
Abbot yacht If collected at Brimstone these boats will be
Optic to meet any Surgery in Salem intended to block
